settings.repere: Paragraphe · Every dog is different. Variables like w
settings.text: Every dog is different. Variables like weight, age, activity level and current healthcare are important factors when calculating how many calories your dog should eat in a day. We make this easy.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · When you first join Happy Howl we’ll ask
settings.text: When you first join Happy Howl we’ll ask you questions about your dog to determine how much they should be fed and we’ll provide a handy feeding schedule so you know exactly how much to give them at each meal, no matter how many times a day you are feeding them.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Here’s how it works:
settings.text: Here’s how it works:

settings.repere: Texte · 100% Human-Grade Ingredients are thought
settings.text: 100% Human-Grade Ingredients are thoughtfully sourced from local US farms

settings.repere: Texte · The raw ingredients for each individual
settings.text: The raw ingredients for each individual meal are measured and filled into our BPA free cartons and then vacuum sealed.

settings.repere: Texte · The sealed cartons are then steam-pressu
settings.text: The sealed cartons are then steam-pressure cooked, this eliminates harmful bacteria and retains all nutritional value of the cooked ingredients within the walls of the carton. No need for preservatives

settings.repere: Texte · Once cooked, the food retains it’s quali
settings.text: Once cooked, the food retains it’s quality, freshness and shelf stability for up to 24-months as long as it’s unopened.

settings.text: This is how we achieve a 2 year shelf life with zero preservatives!

settings.repere: Texte · How is Happy Howl different from other d
settings.text: How is Happy Howl different from other dog food brands?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Happy Howl is the most dog-obsessed dog
settings.text: Happy Howl is the most dog-obsessed dog food brand. We have created our company with two things in mind: the best animals on earth and the people who love them most! We also pride ourselves on helping rescues and communities. Our dog-obsessed partnership program helps bring revenue to the people we love most: the dog obsessed. We are also focused on researching and developing the highest quality food, treats and desserts to bring to market in a shelf stable capacity to ensure the food is healthy, convenient, and environmentally friendly.

settings.repere: Texte · Is Happy Howl suitable for all dog breed
settings.text: Is Happy Howl suitable for all dog breeds?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Happy Howl is designed to be enjoyed by
settings.text: Happy Howl is designed to be enjoyed by dogs of all ages, including seniors and puppies, and those with dental challenges. Our meals have a stew-like texture that can easily be served as-is or gently mashed for easier eating, making it accessible for dogs with no teeth or limited chewing ability.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We recommend starting with small serving
settings.text: We recommend starting with small servings and monitoring your dog’s comfort as they transition to our food. Many pet parents have seen seniors and puppies thrive on Happy Howl thanks to its high-quality, wholesome ingredients.

settings.repere: Texte · What standards does Happy Howl meet?
settings.text: What standards does Happy Howl meet?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · All Happy Howl food meets AAFCO standard
settings.text: All Happy Howl food meets AAFCO standards for complete and balanced nutrition for all life stages, including puppies (large breeds too), adult and senior dogs. In addition, all of our food is made with 100% human grade ingredients.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our food is cooked in small batches in a
settings.text: Our food is cooked in small batches in a USDA kitchen and goes through a strict testing process from a certified third-party for quality assurance before it ever leaves our facility. We go the extra mile so you can feel confident that you are feeding your dog the highest quality dog food on the market.

settings.repere: Texte · When are orders fulfilled and shipped?
settings.text: When are orders fulfilled and shipped?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Orders are fulfilled and shipped Monday–
settings.text: Orders are fulfilled and shipped Monday–Friday. We do not process or ship orders on weekends or U.S. holidays. If your order is placed on a weekend or holiday, it will begin processing the next business day.

settings.repere: Texte · What are the ingredients in each recipe?
settings.text: What are the ingredients in each recipe?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Transparency is an important part of who
settings.text: Transparency is an important part of who we are. Not only do we believe dogs deserve better, but so do you. We’re completely up front about what goes into our food. You can find out more about all our ingredients in each recipe on our recipes page.

settings.text: You can manage your subscription by logging in with your email you used during checkout. Please visit our "LOG IN" page at the top of the screen.

settings.repere: Texte · How does Happy Howl support rescues?
settings.text: How does Happy Howl support rescues?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We promote rescues and support their mis
settings.text: We promote rescues and support their mission to help dogs find a furever home or the care they need. As part of our Happy Dogs promise, we are aiming to ease the financial burden on rescues that are doing good in the world through more than just monetary and food assistance. Not only do we promote rescues in our email, social and on our site but we provide affiliate codes for your supporters. You receive commission for every dog that signs up, for every order -- not just the first one.
